names.avg3_170: Chico del Distrito de las Cenizas

steps: Chitose and you come to a limited-time Tanikaze hot spring, which remids Chitose of her hometown…
Sigh... I've been climbing the Monolith way too often lately. I just want to relax for once...
What's with the crowd around that notice board? Some kind of event?
Goodwind Homecare Limited-Time Hot Spring Experience—We look forward to your visit...==W== Goodwind Homecare? You ever heard of them?
Nope. From the name it sounds like a housekeeping company. Why are they running a hot spring?
I remember Goodwind Homecare is run by a group of ninjas. This must be some kind of special assignment...
My ==SEX11==, what are you looking at?
Uwah! Chitose?! When did you get behind me?
From the moment you stepped into the Market, I've been at your back. As your blade, it's only natural that I accompany and protect you.
So Chitose's been shadowing me this whole time... Is my perception that bad, or is it that she's just too good at steathing...?
Goodwind Hot Spring Experience... My ==SEX11==, are you interested in going to a hot spring?
Yeah, kind of. I've been really worn out lately.
Come to think of it, you're from Goodwind, right? You must know all about hot springs.
In the past, while in my homeland, I often trained in hot springs to strengthen myself.
Training ... in the hot spring? You trained while soaking in a hot spring?
Yes. My "Parents" and my "Master" were all tempered in blazing furnaces before becoming blades. I, too, must gradually raise my training temperature if I am ever to truly become your blade.
So to her, bathing in hot springs is a form of forging...
Yes. I'm already accustomed to training in a hot pool. It's how I hone my resistance.
A hot pool, huh... That sounds painful...
My ==SEX11==! I have a proposal! If we train together in the hot spring, surely we will reach the state of Oneness even faster!
Well, since I was going to have a soak anyway, let's give it a try.
Then let us depart at once!
This should be the entrance of Goodwind Homecare Hot Spring. Looks like we're the first guests here.
But there's no one at the door to greet us... Don't tell me this is a trap?
No need to worry. If there's any danger here. I can sense it.
Besides, the sign says "unmanned, self-service hot spring." Once we drop the fee into the box, we can enter.
Oh, I see. Then let's head inside.
It's nice having someone who knows her way around hot springs with me...
Wow, the interior is gorgeous. Quiet and peaceful, not what I expected.
You seem really familiar with this place. Have you been here before?
No. But it's very much like where I once lived. Even if I've never stepped foot here, I know where to go.
So you used to live in a fancy courtyard like this?
Yes, though it was much larger.
So you come from a great house!
My ==SEX11==, there is something I want to know about you.
Please, go ahead. If I can answer it, I will.
Do you ever miss your homeland?
I guess she's homesick, seeing this place.
Sorry... I don't really have any memories of a homeland. So it's hard to answer.
But... Being away for so long, alone... I think I can understand that loneliness.
... Forgive me. I left because I was resolved to find my wielder, yet here I am, still distracted by nostalgia.
As you are my wielder, wherever you are, that is where I belong.
No, no. That's not some petty distraction. Missing home is only human.
Come think about it, I've never really learned about your homeland.
Maybe someday, Chitose, we can visit your homeland together?
Of course! I would be honored and do my utmost to fulfill your wish!
I'm looking forward to that day. But right now, how about that soak?
Of course! This way please, my ==SEX11==.
I'm changing... Is something the matter?
I cannot go into the hot spring dressed like this...
Eh?==W== You're really going to change here? Then I'll use the other room...
To remove one's clothes is to be utterly defenseless. What if an assassin takes this opportunity to attack you?
As your blade, I must always remain at your side, guarding you!
Who would attack me here? Besides, didn't you just say it was safe?
You must never lower your guard, not even in a safe environment! And as your sword, I must keep watch in your place!
Uh... She isn't backing down for a single bit.
After who knows how many rounds of back-and-forth,==W== she finally agreed to set up a folding screen so we could change with our backs to each other.
But in the end, I still couldn't go into the hot pool with her...==W== Because the water Chitose wanted to train in was far, far too scalding for me.
